book.name: LUUKA
book.title: oMwazi Mwinja gwa Yeesu Krisitu nk'oku LUUKA aguyandikaga

content: Omugani g'omuzuuzi muhemusi n'omushumbakazi
Yeesu ashuba guchiira abigirizwa baage ogu mugani y'abayeereka oku bakwaneene gusaliira buzira kuluha.
Aderha ntya: «Omu gishagala chiguma haliiri omuzuuzi muguma orhayuubahaga Nnamahanga na nta muntu akengaga.
Kandi mw'echo gishagala haliiri omushumbakazi muguma wagendaga aja kubwira oyo muzuuzi ntya: ‹Onchiire bwinja olushinja n'omushombanyi waani!›
Halenga siku zinene alahiire kumuchiira lo. Aliko buzinda achibwira ntya: ‹Nachiro mpu ntayuubaha Nnamahanga na nta muntu nkenga,
aliko bunoola oyu mushumbakazi ali andunza, namuchiira bwinja olushinja lwage, arhayinja kumbera erhwe.›»
Nnaweerhu aja aderha ntya: «Muyunve bwinja eby'oyu muzuuzi muhemusi aderhere!
Ka Nnamahanga yeewe arhagachiira bwinja olushinja abantu baage achishogere, n'obo bali bamulilira ezuuba n'obudufu? Ka nj'alegama kubarhabaala?
Mbabwirire oku Nnamahanga nj'abachiira bwinja olushinja jubaajuba. Sy'aliko amango Mwene oMuntu nj'agaluka, ka nj'abugaana obwemeezi omu gulu?»
Omugani g'oMufarisaayo n'omufurhiisa w'amakooli
Yeesu ashuba gucha ogu mugani oku bantu baliiri guchiibona oku bakwaneene n'ogukena abandi bantu:
«Lusiku luguma, bantu babiri baja gusaliira omu Nju ya Nnamahanga. Muguma aliiri Mufarisaayo n'owindi aliiri mufurhiisa w'amakooli.

oMufarisaayo ayimanga, asaliira ntya omu murhima gwage: ‹Nnamahanga wee, nguheere obukuuze bulaala ntali kuguma n'abandi bantu. Boowe bali bishumuusi, barhakwaneene, bali bahushi. Kandi ntali kuguma n'oyu mufurhiisa w'amakooli.
Nanchiibuza kulya kabiri omu boso, nampaana chigabi chiguma ch'ekumi ch'ebintu mbona.›

Aliko omufurhiisa w'amakooli yeewe, aliyimangire hale. Chiro arhanagalaga kuyinamula ameesho elugulu, sy'aliko achishuurha egifuba omu kuyeerekana oku arhakwaneene. Aderha ntya: ‹Yoo! Nnamahanga, ombeere obonjo, nye munyabyaaha!›

Yeesu aja aderha ntya: ‹Mbabwirire, oyu mufurhiisa w'amakooli yi wagalukire emwage ey'akwaneene, si arhali ola Mufarisaayo. Kwenge ngasi muntu yeeshi wachizamuula nj'ayandagazwa, aliko ola wachiyandagaza nj'azamuulwa.›»
Yeesu agisha abaana badoorho
Bantu baguma baleerhera Yeesu enjolyaana nazo mpu azigishe omu kuzihira kw'amaboko. Abigirizwa baage babeere baabona ntyo, bakalihira abo bantu.
Aliko Yeesu arhegeka oku bamuleerhere abo baana n'okuderha ntya: «Muleke abaana bayinje emunda ndi! Murhababuzaga, bulaala oBwami bwa Nnamahanga buli bw'abantu bali kuguma nabo.
Mbabwirire okuli: omuntu orhayankiriire oBwami bwa Nnamahanga nka mwana mudoorho arhakabuja mo chiro n'ehityu.»
Yeesu aganiira n'omugale muguma
Omukulu muguma w'aBayaahudi abaza Yeesu ntya: «Mwigiriza mwinja, bichi ngwasize kujira yi mbona akalamo k'esiku n'amango?»
Yeesu amushubiza ntya: «Gurhe wankanyirika mwinja? Nta muntu mwinja, arhali Nnamahanga yenyine.
Sy'omenyere amarhegeko: ‹Orhahushaga, orhayirhaga, orhazimbaga, orhahamiirizaga obubeeshi, okenge yisho na nyoko.›»
Oyo mukulu ashubiza ntya: «Ama marhegeko mooshi namakengere gurhenga ndi musole.»

Yeesu abeere ayunva ntyo, amubwira ntya: «Hachikubuliire kandi chintu chiguma: oguze ebintu byooshi ogwerhe, efuranga zarhenga mo ozigabire abakene, nji wanaja wagwarha obuchire omu mpingu. Wanaja wayinja n'okunkulikira.»
Aliko oyo muntu abeere ayunva ntyo, agaya bweneene, bulaala aliiri muchire bweneene.
Yeesu abwene oku agayire, aderha ntya: «Okuli, bikomereere abachire kuja omu Bwami bwa Nnamahanga!
Bulaala kuyoloheere bweneene engamiya kugera omu hirhule hy'esindani ahaali h'omugale kuja omu Bwami bwa Nnamahanga.»
Abantu baliiri bamuyunviriza baderha ntya: «Nde leero wagachungulwa?»
Yeesu ashubiza ntya: «Ebirhakagalika oku bantu byakagalika emwa Nnamahanga.»
Petero aja aderha ntya: «Tala oku rhwewe rhwalekere ebintu rhwali rhugwerhe yi rhugukulikira.»
Yeesu ababwira ntya: «Mbabwire okuli, nta muntu walekere enju, mukaage, beene baabo, abazeere baage changwa abaana baage elugulu w'obwime bwa Nnamahanga,
orhakayankirira ebintu binene mu mano mango, n'omu siku zayinja nj'abona akalamo k'esiku n'amango.»
Yeesu abala kandi ogufa n'ogufuuka kwage
Buzinda bw'aho, Yeesu arhoola zila ntumwa zaage ekumi n'ebiri n'okuzibwira ntya: «Tala oku rhwazamuukira eYerusaleema; byooshi byayandikwaga n'abaleebi bilolere Mwene oMuntu byajirika.
Bulaala nj'ahaanwa oku barhali Bayaahudi. Nji bamushinyagulira, nji bamulibuza, nji bamuchiira ko,
nji bamushuurha, nji banamuyirha. N'olusiku lwa gasharhu nj'afuuka.»
Aliko barhayunvaga eby'echi chinwa chiderhere, bulaala byaali bishirwe. Barhaalimenyere bichi Yeesu ashondaga kuderha.
Yeesu afumya empumi eYeeriko
Amango Yeesu ayegeeraga egishagala ch'eYeeriko, haliiri empumi nguma yali yikeere eburhambi bw'enjira ey'eri yahemuuza.
Eyo mpumi yayunva abantu banene yi baagera, yanabaza bichi byabeere.
Bayishubiza ntya: «Yeesu w'eNazareeti yeeri kulenga.»
Empumi yaliika omulenge: «Yeesu, Mwene Daawudi, ombeere obonjo!»
Abaliiri balambagira embere bayikalihira yi bayisizya, aliko yayaama bweneene: «Mwene Daawudi, ombeere obonjo!»
Yeesu ayimanga n'ogurhegeka oku bayileerhere ye. Empumi yabeere yaagera hoofu naye, Yeesu ayibaza ntya:
«Gichi oshondere nkujirirage?» Yashubiza ntya: «Nnaweerhu, nshube mbone.»
Yeesu ayishubiza ntya: «Shuba kubona; obwemeezi bwawe bwagufumize.»
Ho n'aho yabona n'okumukulikira ey'eri yakuuza Nnamahanga. Olubaga looshi lwabeere lwabona ebyoola, lwarhondera gukuuza Nnamahanga.
